categories.main_business_segments: JL MAG Rare-Earth Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance rare earth permanent magnets (REPMs), magnetic components, and recycling of REPMs. Its products serve key sectors including new energy vehicles (NEVs) and automotive parts, energy-saving variable-frequency air conditioners (VFACs), wind power, robots and industrial servo motors, 3C electronics, low-altitude aircraft, energy-saving elevators, and rail transit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies such as grain boundary diffusion (GBD) technology, formulation systems, grain refinement, primary molding, production automation, and advanced surface coating technologies. Its manufacturing process covers full production stages including raw material batching, hydrogen decrepitation, jet milling, vacuum melting, high-temperature sintering, orientation pressing, magnetization, machining, surface treatment, testing, and assembly of magnetic components. The company also emphasizes recycling and reuse of rare earth materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JL MAG serves leading global manufacturers in NEVs, with its products adopted by the world's top ten NEV manufacturers for drive motors. It also supplies eight of the top ten VFAC compressor manufacturers and five of the top ten wind turbine manufacturers worldwide. Other customers include companies in the robotics, 3C electronics, low-altitude aircraft, and rail transit sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China with production facilities in Ganzhou (Jiangxi Province), Baotou (Inner Mongolia), Ningbo (Zhejiang Province), and Jincheng. It has subsidiaries and market presence in Hong Kong SAR, Europe, Japan, the United States, Mexico, and South Korea. Approximately 79% of revenue is from Mainland China, with the remainder from other countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: JL MAG operates in the midstream segment of the rare earth permanent magnet supply chain, focusing on processing rare earth raw materials into high-performance NdFeB magnets and magnetic components. It procures rare earth raw materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, particularly in reducing medium and heavy rare earth usage, enhancing automation, and upgrading production facilities. It actively invests in R&D for magnetic components used in humanoid robots, aiming to scale production for mass market. Strategic plans include expanding production capacity to 60,000 tonnes by 2027 and developing advanced production lines for humanoid robot components. The company also emphasizes ESG initiatives and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: JL MAG generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-performance NdFeB permanent magnets and magnetic components. It operates a make-to-order production model, purchasing raw materials based on confirmed orders and delivering customized products to customers. Revenue is derived from product sales across multiple downstream sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JL MAG is positioned as a global leader and the largest manufacturer of high-performance REPMs by production and sales volume, both in China and worldwide. It holds leading market shares in key sectors such as NEVs, energy-saving VFACs, and wind power. The company maintains strong competitive advantages through proprietary technologies, strategic partnerships with major rare earth suppliers, and long-term stable customer relationships. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, JL MAG achieved revenue of RMB6.76 billion, a 1.13% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to owners of RMB291 million, reflecting a 48.37% decrease due to raw material price declines and increased competition. The company produced approximately 29,300 tonnes of REPM blanks and sold 20,900 tonnes of finished products, both record highs with about 40% volume growth. Total assets reached RMB12.3 billion with a debt ratio of 42.12%. The company maintains strong cash reserves and a sound financial system.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JL MAG emphasizes its strong production capacity, advanced proprietary technologies (notably GBD technology), and comprehensive R&D capabilities to deliver high-quality, high-performance NdFeB magnets and magnetic components. It offers customized solutions aligned with stringent customer requirements, ensuring product quality, reliability, and delivery. The company’s leadership in ESG practices and commitment to sustainable development further differentiate it by contributing to carbon emission reductions and green manufacturing.
